cards.headline: The tape: a broad bid, 60% of energy names green
cards.body: SPX +0.70% · WTI -1.83% · Brent -5.48% · NatGas +14.89%. 60% of 67 energy names are green — a broad bid. Grid, Storage & Electrification is doing the heavy lifting at +4.30%.

cards.headline: Grid, Storage & Electrification leads, Renewables & Solar lags
cards.body: Strongest energy sector is Grid, Storage & Electrification at +4.30%; weakest is Renewables & Solar at -0.48%. Rotation within the energy trade, not a one-way move.

cards.headline: BE is the standout at +7.48%
cards.body: Leaders: BE +7.48%, GEV +5.64%, VRT +4.77%, AR +3.96%, DINO +3.45%. Laggards: EOSE -5.23%, SEDG -5.05%, ENPH -4.27%, RUN -3.83%.
cards.watch: Hot means attention, not direction — watch whether the leaders hold the bid or fade into the next session.
